name: TRAD hypertension research EN-ES
counting_policy: 657 stable canonical terminology records after the original grouping of 10 lexical variants; every canonical EN/preferred ES pair individually crosschecked in external sources. Includes clinical entities, drugs, procedures, units and conference/research vocabulary. Aliases/inflections do not add to the count and are not all verified; this is not 657 distinct diseases or independent clinician certification.

sources.notes: Spanish original publication with bilingual author keywords: edema pulmonar flash. Preferred Spanish rendering checked by contextual definition.

sources.title: Glomerular hypertension: cause and consequence of renal injury
sources.notes: Primary published specialist review; glomerular capillary hypertension, not arteriolar pressure. Terminology only.

sources.title: Licorice-induced hypertension: pseudohyperaldosteronism due to jelly bean ingestion
Effectiveness of Short-Acting Oral Antihypertensives in Asymptomatic Markedly Elevated Blood Pressure
sources.organization: NLM PubMed / J Clin Med Research
sources.notes: Primary retrospective cohort; terminology attestation, not endorsement of acute treatment.

sources.title: Clinical, obstetric and perinatal characteristics of Mexican pregnant women with COVID-19
sources.notes: Spanish primary study, table footnote distinguishes perinatal death from mortality rate.

sources.title: Lp(a) elevada y su asociación con la aterosclerosis subclínica
sources.notes: Authored specialist Spanish narrative; terminology only.

sources.title: ARA-II: revisión basada en la evidencia, farm@drid
sources.notes: Official authored assessment report; historical terminology, not current indications or recommendations.

sources.title: Consenso Argentino de Hipertensión Arterial 2025
sources.organization: Sociedad Argentina de Hipertensión Arterial / sociedades participantes
sources.notes: Primary Spanish specialist consensus. Selected terminology only; does not replace ESC, AHA/ACC or KDIGO.

sources.title: The JNC 7 report
sources.notes: Historical primary guideline publication, DOI 10.1001/jama.289.19.2560.

sources.title: Renal parenchymal hypertension: relevant new aspects
sources.notes: English title and abstract of Czech publication; English abstract only, not full article reading.

sources.title: Prueba de dexametasona
sources.notes: Official clinical dictionary distinguishes nocturnal suppression from two-day variants; terminology only.

sources.title: Adherencia al tratamiento de enfermedades crónicas en adultos mayores con hipertensión arterial y diabetes tipo 2
sources.organization: Revista de Investigación e Innovación en Salud
sources.notes: Elcy Cecilia Nieto Poveda, Revista de Investigación e Innovación en Salud, authored review. PDF sections on biochemical drug-level testing in serum and urine; not HbA1c as proof of medication intake.

sources.title: Preoperative alpha-blockade in phaeochromocytoma and paraganglioma
sources.notes: Primary published review, DOI 10.1111/cen.13284. Terminology only, not endorsement of universal blockade.

sources.title: OUTREACH: chemical adherence testing-guided intervention
sources.organization: NLM PMC / The Lancet Primary Care
sources.notes: Primary randomized trial, DOI 10.1016/j.lanprc.2026.100154. Chemical/biochemical adherence measurement terminology.

sources.title: Riñón y enfermedad cardíaca
sources.notes: Primary Spanish society monograph; historical terminology, including ASCOT-BPLA narrative.

sources.title: Ficha técnica: solución glucosalina, precauciones con sales de sodio
sources.notes: Official Spanish regulatory document; chemical class label only, not an infusion recommendation.

sources.title: A simplified direct radioimmunoassay for urinary aldosterone
sources.notes: English abstract of primary assay study, DOI 10.1507/endocrine1927.55.3_161. Stable unit micrograms/day only; no historical reference intervals exported.

sources.title: Prediction of Ambulatory Hypertension Based on Clinic Blood Pressure Percentile in Adolescents
sources.notes: Primary study, DOI 10.1161/HYPERTENSIONAHA.118.11530. Percentile terminology only.

sources.title: Alcohol-Mediated Renal Denervation Using the Peregrine System Infusion Catheter
sources.notes: Primary trial, DOI 10.1016/j.jcin.2019.10.048; publication has an erratum. Terminology only.

sources.title: Manejo perioperatorio del feocromocitoma. Reporte de un caso
sources.notes: Primary case report; DOI 10.25237/revchilanestv50n02-03. Explicit bloqueo alfaadrenérgico preoperatorio; no efficacy claim inferred from the case.

sources.title: Consenso SIAC sobre sacubitrilo/valsartán
sources.organization: Sociedad Interamericana de Cardiología / Archivos de Cardiología de México
sources.notes: Authored consensus explicitly names manejo basado en las guías de práctica clínica; general conference vocabulary, not evidence equating systemic and pulmonary hypertension.

sources.title: Prevención cardiovascular en el paciente con enfermedad metabólica, segunda edición
sources.notes: Institution-hosted authored specialist textbook; verify publication date from actual file. Spanish narrative identifies CLICK.

sources.title: Cómo entender sus resultados de pruebas de laboratorio
sources.notes: Official laboratory unit glossary: Mcg/dL = microgramos por decilitro.

sources.title: Estado actual de la denervación renal simpática en el tratamiento de la hipertensión
sources.organization: Archivos de Cardiología de México / SciELO
sources.notes: Primary Spanish authored review; narrative identifies SPYRAL HTN-OFF MED and RADIANCE-HTN TRIO, not bibliography only.

sources.title: Chlorthalidone for Hypertension in Advanced Chronic Kidney Disease, full text
sources.notes: Full primary CLICK trial publication, counterpart of S21. DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2110730.

sources.title: Revista médica científica Red Dávila, vol. 2 núm. 1, edición 2025: discusión de hipertensión asintomática
sources.notes: Indexed excerpt of Spanish journal, printed p.53; direct download returned 403 and browser redirected to home. Full PDF and article byline not verified. Exact Spanish label distinguishes marked asymptomatic elevation from emergency with acute organ damage.

sources.title: Arteriografía renal
sources.notes: Official Spanish description of renal angiography and guided arterial stent placement.

sources.title: Guideline-Driven Management of Hypertension: An Evidence-Based Update
sources.notes: Primary authored review, DOI 10.1161/CIRCRESAHA.121.318083; exact English phrase guideline-driven management.

sources.title: ¿Qué es la presión arterial alta? Categorías AHA en español
sources.notes: Official Spanish table distinguishes severe hypertension without listed symptoms from hypertensive emergency. Supplementary context, not a clinical diagnosis from numbers alone.

sources.title: Tratamiento del hiperaldosteronismo primario durante el embarazo: reporte de un caso
sources.organization: Ginecología y Obstetricia de México / SciELO
sources.notes: Primary Spanish case report and clinical discussion explicitly defines producción autónoma de aldosterona independiente de la actividad de renina.

sources.title: Titulación de dosis en IC con FE reducida: mucho por medir, mucho por hacer
sources.notes: Spanish specialist discussion of longitudinal medication titration, including dose increases and decreases; term evidence, not a hypertension-specific treatment recommendation.
